result.topic_en: Draft notes on Fourier (trigonometric) series: whether the coefficient formulas presuppose integrability of the function, examples of series that are not Fourier series but whose integrated series represent continuous, integrable functions, and an estimate of the second symmetric difference $F(x+\alpha+\beta)+F(x-\alpha-\beta)-2F(x)$.
